notes: Read SKILL.md and 01_stride_analysis.md, 02_feature_threats.md, 03_architecture_impact.md, 04_code_review.md, 05_security_tests.md, 06_owasp_check.md, 07_payment_security.md, 08_update_model.md in full. The skill is a set of prompt templates for STRIDE threat modeling, feature/architecture threat analysis, security code review, security test generation, an OWASP Top 10 2021 checklist, and a Clerk Billing + Stripe payment security assessment.

Following it makes the agent write reports and tests into the user's project (docs/security/THREAT_MODEL.md, docs/security/reviews/*.md, __tests__/...security.test.ts) and optionally run `npm test`, a curl against localhost to check webhook signature rejection, and the Stripe CLI (`stripe listen` / `stripe trigger`) in the user's own test setup (05_security_tests.md:161-173, 07_payment_security.md:164-176); no installs, secrets handling, or remote calls beyond the user's local app and their own Stripe CLI session.

Template dependence: the prompts are written for the author's Secure Vibe Coding OS starter (Next.js, Clerk, Convex, Stripe) and reference project docs such as @docs/security/SECURITY_ARCHITECTURE.md and helpers withCsrf/withRateLimit/handleApiError (04_code_review.md:44-50) that the user's project may not have; the threat-modeling methodology still works in any project. SKILL.md:207 and :320 assume an install path `.claude/skills/security/security-prompts/threat-modeling/`; the template files themselves ship in this directory. Pointers to the sibling prompt-engineering skill (SKILL.md:301-304, 04_code_review.md:124, 05_security_tests.md:198) and to threat-modeler/security-scanner/security-reporter agents are optional and not shipped.

Minor inaccuracy: 04_code_review.md:67 maps XML external entities to A04:2021 (in OWASP 2021 XXE falls under A05 Security Misconfiguration). The OWASP section uses only category names and paraphrased questions.
